events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, was born on this day in Akron, Ohio, in 1951.

angles.name: Hynde's Enduring Influence
angles.copy: Celebrating Chrissie Hynde's 75th birthday today! From punk rock pioneer to enduring icon, her distinctive voice and uncompromising style have left an indelible mark on music.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Born in Manchester in 1972, William John Paul Gallagher, known as Liam Gallagher, is an English singer and songwriter, famed as the lead vocalist of Oasis and later Beady Eye.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The unmistakable voice of a generation, still bringing that swagger and those anthems.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971, featuring his iconic title track.

angles.name: Imagine's Timeless Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today – what world do you imagine?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the very first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Celebrating 007
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to the world's most iconic secret agent. What's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was born in Liverpool on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on this day in Weston-super-Mare in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Genius Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to classic hotel chaos, his comedic genius is truly unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album's Impact
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A double LP that broke all the rules and showcased their incredible diversity. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who we lost on this day in 1991. His voice, stage presence, and legacy remain legendary. He would have been 80.

events.title: The Beatles 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Legacy
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! 61 years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced generations.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world lost a musical visionary when John Lennon was tragically killed in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: 46 years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. Forever in our thoughts. He would have been 86.
